info.name: T-Kart E-Commerce Platform API
info.description: Import the companion T-Kart Local environment and run this collection against the local API. The suite creates its own customer and catalog fixtures. Set adminPassword in your local environment to the seeded administrator password before running.

item.name: Other Customer Cannot Read This Order (Expected 404)

exec: const expected = { 'Simulate Failed Payment': 402, 'Get Failed Payment': 200, 'Retry Payment Successfully': 200, 'Get Successful Payment': 200, 'Other Customer Cannot Read Payment (Expected 404)': 404, 'Reject Payment on Paid Order (Expected 409)': 409 };

if (pm.info.requestName === 'Simulate Failed Payment') pm.test('Failure is recorded independently', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.payment.status).to.eql('failed'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.order.paymentInfo.status).to.eql('failed'); });

if (pm.info.requestName === 'Retry Payment Successfully') pm.test('Retry marks order paid', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.payment.status).to.eql('success'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.order.paymentInfo.status).to.eql('paid'); });
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Get Failed Payment') pm.test('Failed payment lookup is owned and persisted', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('failed'); });
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Get Successful Payment') pm.test('Successful payment lookup is persisted', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('success'); });

const expected = { 'Negative Test: Inventory Requires Admin (Expected 403)': 403, 'Get Inventory': 200, 'Negative Test: Invalid Stock (Expected 400)': 400, 'Update Product Stock': 200, 'Get Admin Orders': 200, 'Get Admin Dashboard': 200, 'Get Admin Customers': 200, 'Pause Customer Access': 200, 'Restore Customer Access': 200, 'Reject Invalid Order Transition (Expected 409)': 409, 'Start Order Processing': 200, 'Ship Order': 200, 'Deliver Order': 200, 'Cancel Unpaid Order': 200, 'Get Product Stock After Cancellation': 200, 'Repeat Cancellation (Expected 409)': 409, 'Delete Product (Admin - Soft Delete)': 200 };

if (pm.info.requestName === 'Get Admin Dashboard') pm.test('Dashboard returns metrics and operational lists', function () { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.metrics).to.have.property('paidRevenue'); pm.expect(data.metrics).to.have.property('totalCustomers'); pm.expect(data.recentOrders).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(data.lowStockProducts).to.be.an('array'); });

if (pm.info.requestName === 'Get Admin Customers') { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Customer list is paginated and sanitized', function () { pm.expect(body.pagination).to.have.property('totalItems'); pm.expect(body.data[0]).to.not.have.property('password'); }); if (body.data[0]) pm.collectionVariables.set('adminCustomerId', body.data[0]._id); }
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Pause Customer Access') pm.test('Customer access is paused', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.isActive).to.eql(false); });
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Restore Customer Access') pm.test('Customer access is restored', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.isActive).to.eql(true); });

if (pm.info.requestName === 'Get Product Stock After Cancellation') pm.test('Cancellation restored stock once', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.stock).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('phase8CancelStockBefore'))); });
